digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The rollout schedule shifted today, and a few follow-ups remain for the days ahead.

items.label: Confirm coverage for the revised Wave 2 rollout
items.detail: The original support bridge was cancelled and replaced by separate go-live sessions. Wednesday's Paralegal session is at 2:30 PM, overlapping Astrid's 1:1; Tier 2 CS follows at 4:30 PM. Confirm coverage and activation support.

items.label: Review MHE expansion approval drafts
items.detail: Review the drafts relevant to your area and send approval or comments by Thursday, November 19. The sender will treat silence as approval; provider responses and the candidate list also affect Friday's pilot decision.

items.label: Review EKM dependencies with Nicolas
items.detail: The project is at risk but preparation continues. Clarify the IT perspective, approval workflow, governance ownership, Salesforce readiness, and Legal review capacity before the next status update.

items.label: Clarify Universal Intake project leadership
items.detail: The kickoff chat asks who will be the project lead and sponsor. Frank is listed as the business analyst in the assignment notice; confirm the remaining leadership roles.

items.label: Amazon Connect daily standup
items.detail: The standup was cancelled due to the Virtual Queues rollout.

items.label: CM CoE Phase 1 and 2 alignment
items.detail: The monthly meeting was cancelled; the cancellation noted that the CoE backlog had been cleaned up with Product's help.

items.label: 3:00 PM - LeadUp and EPMO team meeting overlap
items.detail: Laura's 1:1 begins at 3:30 PM. Confirm coverage or reschedule; only one of the two offered LeadUp sessions is required.
